name: How do contractors manage dust during indoor drywall repairs?

mainEntity.name: How do contractors manage dust during indoor drywall repairs?

acceptedAnswer.text: Drywall work generates fine gypsum dust, but professional contractors take strict containment steps to protect your living space. Technicians set up plastic dust barriers at doorways, cover flooring with drop cloths, and mask air vents in the immediate workspace. Additionally, using damp-sponging techniques or fine-grit hand sanding minimizes airborne particles. Once sanding is complete, the crew vacuums the immediate area before priming and painting, leaving your living room or bedroom clean and ready for daily use.
acceptedAnswer.description: Crews seal doorways with plastic, protect floors with drop cloths, use controlled sanding methods, and vacuum thoroughly before applying primer and paint.
